summary: Cache complete web-integrator PR file lists and bound selection with an explicit deadline outcome.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of application data.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only integrator behavior. Existing state remains readable; PR file lists use a new cache namespace. Trust is rechecked every tick. Incomplete or over-3000-file PRs are skipped as files-incomplete instead of admitted from truncated metadata; other PRs continue. Selection deadlines are logged separately from build failures.

downtime.detail: No running deployment is changed by this commit.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment owners can configure the default 60-second selection budget.

recovery.detail: Expired selection retains the served build and retries next tick. Cache entries can be discarded without migrating production state.
